svg.text: ESP32 DevKit (30 pin) · 2 × L298N · 4 × TT motor · HC-SR04 · 2 × VL53L0X · 2 × TCRT5000 · VS1838B · 2 × 18650 (7.4 V)
5 V jumper ON · ENA/ENB jumpers ON
5 V jumper ON · ENA/ENB jumpers ON
mounted upside down on the deck, pins up
→ VCC/VIN of both lasers, both TCRT5000s and the VS1838B
• 5 V jumper on both L298Ns; only the LEFT +5V feeds the ESP32.
• Leave ENA/ENB jumpers on: the IN pins carry the PWM (20 kHz).
• ECHO is 5 V: always through the 1k / 2k divider into GPIO34.
• Every GND is common: battery −, both L298Ns, ESP32, sensors.
• Charge the 18650s one at a time on the TP4056.
